## Accepted quantitative pyjama partial, attempt 1/5

Problem 171 / GREEN-083, rank 1260; original Green Problem 41, not Problem 83. The original model uses closed periodic unit-scale strips, rotations about the origin only, and coverage of every point of the entire plane.

For 0<epsilon<1/2, the complete proof establishes N(epsilon)>=ceil(max(pi/(2 arcsin(epsilon/(1-epsilon))),1+1/(2epsilon))) and liminf epsilon N(epsilon)>=pi/2. The first-circle bound improves the explicitly cited volume baseline by asymptotic factor pi, while retaining order epsilon^(-1). The exact central-disk angular-gap criterion, complete pairwise-density averaging argument, and credited boundary examples are preserved.

The asymptotic-order problem remains unresolved by this work. No improved upper bound, superlinear lower-bound order, polynomial upper bound or whole-plane sufficiency from disk sharpness is claimed. Manners, Kravitz–Leng, Malikiosis–Matolcsi–Ruzsa and Malikiosis are credited with their precise hypotheses and source-review limits. Novelty is not certified.

## Publication boundary and review limits

Exactly six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/171/`. The audit required no mathematical correction. Its optional clarifications, explicit epsilon range in Proposition 2 and measurability in the periodic averaging lemma, are applied. Every mathematical statement, complete proof, authored example and source qualification is retained.

Programs, checker outputs, computational results, fixtures, datasets, copied third-party source bodies and private coordination/version identities are excluded. No excluded computation is recast as prose. The edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed; scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Recorded retrieval and inspection are historical observations. Edition preparation claims no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries are unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
